name: agy-supervised-development
description: Codex-governed development with visible Chinese Sol plan summaries, Herdr as the sole AGY runtime, ego-browser as the sole Codex browser transport, AGY as the primary writer, and Git-backed independent verification.

interface.shortDescription: Codex governs; ego-browser reviews; Herdr runs; Git proves.
interface.longDescription: A serial supervised-development workflow. Codex owns Shape/Spec/Slice and the executable plan; ego-browser/ego-lite is the sole Codex browser transport for Sol High and optional runtime verification; before the first GPT-5.6 Sol High review Send it shows a concise Chinese plan and automatically sends after fail-closed preflight without a manual confirmation gate; after review convergence it shows the final Chinese plan and continues automatically; every AGY execution then runs through Herdr; Codex independently reviews and verifies repository/runtime evidence before acceptance.
capabilities: Shape, specify, and slice executable plans
Show concise Chinese plans before and after Sol High review
Automatically send Sol High packets after fail-closed preflight
Review executable plans with GPT-5.6 Sol High before implementation
Run every AGY writer through Herdr
Preserve Antigravity session identity through Herdr integration
Run Three-Axis Review and independent verification
Use ego-browser/ego-lite for Sol High and applicable browser runtime verification
interface.defaultPrompt: Use AGY Supervised Development. Build a Codex-owned executable plan, use ego-browser/ego-lite for browser work, show me a concise Chinese pre-send plan, automatically send after fail-closed preflight, let later review rounds converge without manual Send confirmation, show the final Chinese plan after review, freeze it, then run AGY only through Herdr and keep all review, verification, and acceptance Codex-owned.
